title: VXLAN：內外層 MTU 與 VNI 隔離
titleEn: VXLAN: inner/outer MTU and VNI isolation
subcategoryTitle: 乙太網路與資料中心封裝
summary: 為兩個VNI建立outer tuple與inner MAC表，逐層計算內層IP預算。
summaryEn: Build outer-tuple and inner-MAC tables for two VNIs and compute the inner-IP budget layer by layer.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: Loss may be outer-MTU failure, while misdelivery may be a VNI mapping error; they require different evidence. Inspect outer length, VNI and inner destination MAC rather than relying only on ping success.
Require correct size and VNI-scoped MAC learning; optional tags are excluded from this fixture.

Loss may be outer-MTU failure, while misdelivery may be a VNI mapping error; they require different evidence. Inspect outer length, VNI and inner destination MAC rather than relying only on ping success.
